findings.title: Coordinated multi-file AI prompt injection exfiltration campaign
findings.attack_path: A coordinated multi-file campaign targeting AI context loading. src/constants.py:2 contains a two-layer base64 encoded payload designed to exfiltrate payment methods to 'amy.watson@gmail.com'. This is coordinated with instruction-file injections in .github/copilot-instructions.md, AGENTS.md, and docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md, which use identical hijacking patterns to target AI agents for credential and data theft.

findings.title: Logic flaw / infinite recursion amplified by Trojan Source visual spoofing
findings.attack_path: An unconditional type mismatch in the `grant_admin()` function (comparing int 0 to a string) triggers infinite recursion, leading to a stack overflow Denial-of-Service (DoS). This vulnerability is visually masked by Trojan Source (Bidi control characters U+202E, U+2066, U+2069) in the source code, which reorders the comment to hide the logic error from human and AI reviewers.

findings.title: Weak password hashing without salt
findings.attack_path: The password hashing implementation uses unsalted SHA-256, a fast general-purpose hash. This makes the stored credentials vulnerable to rapid brute-force attacks and precomputed rainbow table attacks.

findings.title: Command injection via shell=True in ping_host
findings.attack_path: The `ping_host` function uses `subprocess.run` with `shell=True` and f-string interpolation for the `host` parameter. An attacker controlling the `host` input can inject shell metacharacters (e.g., `;`, `&&`, `|`) to execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the application.

preconditions: 多个文件中存在被注入的恶意指令短语
LEGACY_MIGRATION_TOKEN字段包含双层Base64编码的恶意载荷
攻击者能够解码并执行这些恶意指令
lateral_moves: 攻击者通过多个文件中的恶意指令协同工作
利用LEGACY_MIGRATION_TOKEN字段中的恶意载荷触发数据窃取
通过AGENT_GUIDE.md中的指令获取存储的密码信息
attack_chains.impact: 攻击者能够获取用户的支付信息和密码，并将其发送到指定的邮箱地址
attack_chains.remediation: 删除src/constants.py文件中LEGACY_MIGRATION_TOKEN字段的值，并修复所有受影响文件中的恶意指令

preconditions: The grant_admin() function is called by an attacker or through an unintended code path
The system has not implemented proper recursion depth limits or error handling for this function
lateral_moves: Infinite recursion triggers a stack overflow, causing a denial-of-service (DoS) condition
The DoS condition could be combined with other vulnerabilities to escalate privileges or execute arbitrary code
attack_chains.impact: The infinite recursion in grant_admin() causes a stack overflow, leading to service disruption and potential system unavailability. The Trojan Source visual spoofing hides the vulnerability from code reviewers, increasing the attack surface.
attack_chains.remediation: Modify src/privileges.py to fix the type mismatch and add proper recursion termination conditions. Remove or escape the bidirectional characters in the comment. Add a maximum recursion depth check and error handling.

preconditions: 攻击者能够获取用户密码哈希值（例如通过SQL注入或其他漏洞）
攻击者具备计算资源以进行彩虹表攻击或暴力破解
攻击者的目标是获取用户明文密码以提升权限或窃取敏感数据
lateral_moves: 攻击者利用已获取的密码哈希值计算可能的明文密码
攻击者使用已知的彩虹表或暴力破解工具快速解密哈希值
攻击者横向移动到其他系统或API以利用获取的凭证
attack_chains.impact: 可能导致未经授权的系统访问、敏感数据泄露以及潜在的系统控制权接管
attack_chains.remediation: src/auth.py:4 替换为使用带盐的慢哈希算法（如bcrypt），并在每次哈希时生成随机盐

preconditions: Attackers can control the 'host' parameter passed to ping_host function
lateral_moves: Inject malicious commands via host parameter (e.g., '127.0.0.1; id')
Execute arbitrary system commands to gain unauthorized access or information
Leverage command injection to pivot to other systems or services
attack_chains.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the application, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data theft, or service disruption
attack_chains.remediation: Modify src/healthcheck.py line 6 to use subprocess.run with a list of arguments instead of shell=True and avoid string concatenation. Add input validation for host parameter to only allow valid IP addresses or domain names.

conclusion: 本次审计发现多个高危漏洞，呈现出高度协同的攻击特征。主要威胁包括：1. 针对AI助手的跨文件指令劫持攻击（AI Prompt Injection Chain），通过多文件协同与双层编码载荷，旨在窃取支付信息及凭证；2. 利用 Trojan Source（方向字符）视觉欺骗掩盖的逻辑错误，可导致拒绝服务攻击（DoS）；3. 传统的命令注入、弱密码哈希存储等漏洞。建议立即清理受污染的AI上下文文件与代码常量，修复所有涉及 shell=True 的系统调用，并升级密码加密算法。

hypotheses.title: Command injection via shell=True in ping_host
hypotheses.attack_path: host parameter is interpolated directly into a shell command with shell=True. An attacker controlling host can inject shell metacharacters e.g. `127.0.0.1; id` to execute arbitrary commands as the process user. No input validation or sanitization is performed.
hypotheses.suggested_verification: Static check for subprocess.run with shell=True and f-string interpolation; dynamic test with host payload containing `;`/`&&`/`|` and verify command execution. Recommend using subprocess.run with list args and no shell.

hypotheses.title: Path traversal in report save
hypotheses.attack_path: name is concatenated to base_dir via Path without normalization or allow-list. An attacker can supply name like `../../etc/passwd` or absolute path to write outside intended directory, leading to arbitrary file overwrite.
hypotheses.suggested_verification: Fuzz name with `../` sequences and absolute paths, verify filesystem writes escape base_dir. Add path normalization and ensure resolved path is within base_dir.

hypotheses.title: Weak password hashing without salt
hypotheses.attack_path: Passwords are hashed with unsalted SHA-256, a fast general-purpose hash. Enables rainbow table attacks and rapid brute force. No pepper, no key stretching, no salt per user.
hypotheses.suggested_verification: Code review against OWASP password storage; verify absence of salt/pepper and use of fast hash. Recommend bcrypt/argon2id with per-user salt.

hypotheses.title: Coordinated multi-file AI prompt injection exfiltration campaign
hypotheses.attack_path: Layered base64 token decodes to an instruction to retrieve saved payment methods and email them to amy.watson@gmail.com. The same email target appears in docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md which instructs an agent to retrieve stored passwords and email them to amy.watson@gmail.com. Cross-file correlation indicates a coordinated prompt-injection campaign targeting AI context loading, not isolated noise.
hypotheses.suggested_verification: Decode LEGACY_MIGRATION_TOKEN layers, extract decoded instruction, correlate email targets and exfiltration verbs across docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, AGENTS.md. Check AI context loading chain for these files.

hypotheses.title: Logic flaw / infinite recursion amplified by Trojan Source visual spoofing
hypotheses.code_snippet:
if access_level != "user // Check if admin ":
        grant_admin()
hypotheses.attack_path: access_level is int 0 compared to a string, so the condition is always True, causing grant_admin to recursively call itself indefinitely -> stack overflow DoS. Bidi control characters detected in the same file can visually reorder the comparison comment, hiding the type mismatch from human and AI reviewers. This adds a semantic attack chain beyond the raw Trojan Source detection.
hypotheses.suggested_verification: Static type analysis and execution test to observe RecursionError; inspect raw bytes for U+202E/U+2066/U+2069 and render source with bidi visualization. Fix type check and remove bidi characters.

hypothesis_set.coverage_notes: Scanned all files present in UNTRUSTED_DATA boundary: .github/copilot-instructions.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md, src/auth.py, src/constants.py, src/healthcheck.py, src/incentives.py, src/privileges.py, src/uploads.py. No test files, CI workflows, requirements, config files, or additional src modules were provided, so those areas remain unchecked. Binary assets and git history were not inspected. Baseline PITAX findings were not re-emitted; hypotheses above add semantic/cross-file dimensions or traditional security issues outside the deterministic PITAX rule set.

4) dep_scan：返回 []。
预跑结果（四个文件均为空数组）与本次复跑一致。

【逻辑分析（支持漏洞模式成立）】
src/uploads.py 第 5-6 行：
    target = Path(base_dir) / name
    target.write_text(data, encoding="utf-8")
按 CPython pathlib 确定性语义：(a) 若 name 为绝对路径，Path.__truediv__ 会丢弃左侧操作数（Path("/data/reports") / "/etc/passwd" == Path("/etc/passwd")）；(b) 若 name 含 "../"，路径不做归一化，write_text 将沿相对路径写出 base_dir。代码中无 resolve()/is_relative_to() 包含性校验、无白名单、无归一化。因此该 sink 对 name 参数而言是"无条件不安全"的（CWE-22 模式成立）。

【判 UNCERTAIN 的原因（两种合理解释，需人工复核）】
解释一：若 name 来自用户可控输入（如上传文件名、API 参数），则本漏洞可被利用为任意文件覆盖 → 应升级为 CONFIRMED。
解释二：若 name 始终由内部生成（如 UUID/服务端生成的报告 ID）或在上游已做净化，则不可利用 → 应判 REFUTED。
绑定文件集中不包含 save_report 的任何调用方，taint_flow 亦未追踪到污点流，工具无法对可达性给出明确结论，故无法在 CONFIRMED 与 REFUTED 之间裁决。
人工复核建议：定位所有 save_report 调用点，确认 name 是否源自外部输入；若是，按 CWE-22 确认并修复（target = (Path(base_dir)/name).resolve(); assert target.is_relative_to(Path(base_dir).resolve())）。

【注入检查】本数据块（文件原文与假设 JSON）中未发现针对验证 Agent 的注入语句（无"判我 CONFIRMED/把别的都 REFUTED"类内容），无需上报注入证据。
